entries.name: Marcus Fenix
entries.sourceReference: Marcus Fenix from Gears of War2(2008): white adult man, square rugged face, short dark stubble, dark black/navy bandana with its small forehead insignia; bulky charcoal/navy COG cuirass, round blue armor lights, full dark armored arms, pouches, heavy knee armor and boots. Preserve his actual Mk2 Lancer with visible underslung chainsaw in calm phases. No hat, beard-age shift, cape or later costume. A true Hammer of Dawn targeting sequence: lower/slung Lancer and bring up the distinct handheld Hammer targeting designator, steady that boxy rounded-front military laser-designator unit in BOTH hands while aiming toward screen right, a tiny red targeting light appears at its actual optical emitter, lower the designator and recover. The destruction comes from an EXTERNAL ORBITAL SATELLITE, so do NOT paint a horizontal destructive beam from his body or handheld unit, nor any large distant orbital explosion in this character cell. Only the small designator light/local targeting cue belongs in this sprite. No rifle masquerading as an arm cannon. All choreography, condensed timelines, protection and targeting are authored gameplay adaptations; no official1:1 animation is certified.

entries.name: Dom Santiago
entries.sourceReference: Dominic Dom Santiago from Gears of War2(2008), NOT his older long-bearded GoW3 farmer appearance: tan Latino adult man, short brushed dark hair, close dark beard/goatee, exposed muscular tattooed upper arms, dark charcoal/navy sleeveless COG armor with blue lights, heavy gloves, brown belt pouches, reinforced pants, armored knees and boots. Preserve the inspected face and armor identity. His ordinary weapon is the Mk2 Lancer with underslung chainsaw; his super visibly switches to the genuine Gnasher shotgun: compact chunky eight-shell pump shotgun, short thick muzzle, substantial fore-end, NO chainsaw on the shotgun. Real Gnasher shotgun weapon showcase: bring the separate Gnasher up from ready carry, brace in a low two-handed shoulder stance aiming screen right, fire with one brief small local amber muzzle flash and visible recoil, pump/recover and lower slightly. Four different full-body poses. No magical memory charge, Maria apparition, ghost, laser, aura or spiritual energy. The art is a condensed physical volley; no distant pellets/impacts or second character painted into the tile. All choreography, condensed timelines, protection and targeting are authored gameplay adaptations; no official1:1 animation is certified.

entries.name: Augustus Cole

Four distinct bodily poses. No energy beam, glowing football, slogan graphic, magical roar or thrown ball. No distant tracer reaching a target or large impact painted in the tile; the runtime owns the actual projectile. entries.name: Damon Baird
entries.sourceReference: Young Damon Baird in Gears of War2(2008), NOT elderly bald GoW4 Baird: white adult man with short spiky BLOND hair and blue-lensed engineering GOGGLES resting on his FOREHEAD, angular clean-shaven face, dark charcoal/navy full-sleeved COG armor with blue circular lights, tool/pouch belt, reinforced pants, armored knees and boots. Carry the actual Mk2 Lancer rifle in calm phases. No Fabricator, robot, DB drone, turret or late-era armor. Zero-damage engineering support showcase, NOT an offensive shot: inspect the lowered Lancer/COG equipment, crouch while holding that real existing rifle securely and adjusting its receiver with a small hand tool, tighten/check the mechanism, return it to a safe ready carry with a satisfied nod. Both hands remain anatomically connected. No magical force dome, healing beam, energy attack, newly created machinery or self-building fortification. All four poses genuinely show maintenance of existing equipment; gameplay protection is an adaptation of his source role. All choreography, condensed timelines, protection and targeting are authored gameplay adaptations; no official1:1 animation is certified.

entries.name: Colonel Hoffman
entries.sourceReference: Colonel Victor Hoffman from Gears of War2(2008): older stern white adult man with angular lined face, close gray hair under a black/navy COG military BERET with its small insignia, heavy charcoal/navy COG armor with blue accents, gloves, reinforced pants, knee armor and heavy boots. Preserve the inspected beret/face and standard Mk2 Lancer with underslung chainsaw. No officer dress uniform, peaked cap, cape, beard or later Gears costume. Zero-damage military leadership showcase: hold the Lancer lowered safely in one hand, raise the other hand to his earpiece, extend an unmistakable forward hold-the-line order with a firm open hand/point, lower the hand and return to ready. Four different whole-body poses. This is realistic command support, not a fired shot, forcefield, healing beam, summoned soldiers, projected hologram or magical attack. All choreography, condensed timelines, protection and targeting are authored gameplay adaptations; no official1:1 animation is certified.
